gen-gf-underdog-gf-koho: Smooth as a rolling-ball pen line, start to finish. Underdog draws every curve at a single width, while the plain sans KoHo keeps wide c openings and a much quieter presence.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-kosugi: Kosugi bends its letters like wire, with a jaw-open c that looks almost pliers-shaped. Underdog is built to command attention with its horseshoe c and unvarying curves, while Kosugi is built for quiet, wire-bent clarity.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-libre-franklin: Smooth tubing up top, a crisp splayed body below. What stands out most is the shift in voice, from the tube-like curves of Underdog to the splayed c terminal of Libre Franklin.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-livvic: Underdog draws every curve at constant weight, with a horseshoe-wide c that announces itself. Livvic follows with friendly, unstressed curves and a generous c opening, which softens the display voice without muting it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-lunasima: Think bent wire, drawn loud, with a horseshoe-wide c and no weight shifts. Underdog does display drama best, while Lunasima, a sans-serif, does quiet text best, its c tips never creeping toward touching.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-1p: Signage-plain and loud: Underdog draws every line alike, with a horseshoe c. M PLUS 1p, a sans-serif open at every curve end, would carry paragraphs smoothly without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Expressive and unbending, Underdog draws every curve at constant weight, its c opened wide like a horseshoe. And M PLUS Code Latin does the friendly text best, its neon-tube letters opening wide like a pitcher.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Underdog draws curves with no thick-thin shift at all. M PLUS Rounded 1c, an approachable sans-serif with terminals that stop short of curling in, would read gently across many lines.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-canadian-ab: Open at every curve end, the body text reads clearly and quietly. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal holds back so Underdog, with its uniformly thick o and horseshoe c, gets the spotlight.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Underdog never produces a hairline, every curve held to one constant stroke with a horseshoe-wide c. And Noto Sans Cypriot, a sans-serif with an e that opens up, gives it a friendly partner on the page.
